definitions.explanation: Describing an institution (school, university, hospital) that is privately owned and operated, not by the government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{私立|しりつ}⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: My son attends a private high school.

examples.japanese: {私立|しりつ}⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: Tuition at private universities is expensive.

examples.japanese: {私立|しりつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{公立|こうりつ}→公立：08210_kouritsu⟧、⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いいですか→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Which is better, private or public?

notes:
{私立|しりつ} indicates a privately owned/operated institution, as opposed to public or government-run ones.

Common collocations:
- {私立|しりつ}{大学|だいがく} (private university)
- {私立|しりつ}{高校|こうこう} (private high school)
- {私立|しりつ}{病院|びょういん} (private hospital)
- {私立|しりつ}{探偵|たんてい} (private detective)

Antonyms:
- {公立|こうりつ} (public - run by local government)
- {国立|こくりつ} (national - run by national government)
- {県立|けんりつ}/{都立|とりつ}/{府立|ふりつ} (prefectural)

Homophone warning: {市立|しりつ} (municipal) has the same reading. Context usually makes it clear, but sometimes people say {市立|いちりつ} or {私立|わたくしりつ} to distinguish.
